note: Corrections to the parent structure 3DSC matched to a cuprate family. Rules use the formula only, never the Tc label. Structures are from the Materials Project (CC BY 4.0), fetched 2026-11-11.

rules.matched_structure: La2CuO4, I4/mmm, T' structure (Nd2CuO4 type): no apical oxygen, Cu-O 2.00 A
rules.replacement_structure: La2CuO4, I4/mmm, T structure (K2NiF4 type): two apical oxygens at 2.46 A, Cu-O 1.91 A
rules.reason: 3DSC matched the whole La2CuO4 family to Materials Project's lowest-energy entry, which is the T' polymorph. Hole-doped La2-x(Sr,Ba,Ca,Na,K)xCuO4 and oxygen-doped La2CuO4+d crystallise in the T structure, which has apical oxygens. Lanthanide-substituted, electron-doped members (La2-xCexCuO4) really are T' and keep the matched structure.

rules.matched_structure: SrCuO2, Cmcm: double Cu-O chains, no CuO2 plane
rules.replacement_structure: SrCuO2, P4/mmm, infinite-layer structure: CuO2 planes separated only by Sr
rules.reason: 3DSC matched Sr1-xLnxCuO2 to the ambient-pressure chain polymorph of SrCuO2. The lanthanide-doped superconductors are the high-pressure infinite-layer phase. Rows without a substituent keep the matched structure because the formula alone does not say which phase was made.
